name: Clam Bait
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You have the look of a fisherman, champion! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?

Up north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
narrative.objectives: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, ""Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better""

Well, I feel better already, thanks mon!
narrative.requestItemsText: I can't wait to go fishing with some fresh soft-shelled clam meat; did you bring me the 10 pieces of it I need?
